content:
We are seeking an experienced AWS Platform Engineer with AgentCore to join a cutting-edge AI platform team. If you have a strong background in AWS cloud engineering, DevOps/SRE, and are passionate about building Agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock and AgentCore, we'd love to hear from you!

🚀 We're Hiring: AWS Platform Engineer with AgentCore 🚀
📍 Location: Reading, PA (Hybrid) – Relocation is Welcome
💼 Employment Type: Contract
🎥 Interview Mode: Video

Required Experience
✅ 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
Core Technical Skills
Strong expertise in AWS (IAM, CloudWatch, Lambda, Bedrock)
Advanced experience with Terraform and CI/CD pipeline automation
Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Dynatrace, Jaeger, or Honeycomb
Understanding of distributed tracing and modern observability practices
Familiarity with LLM lifecycle, prompt execution, token management, and frameworks like LangChain or AgentCore
Experience working in Agile environments using Microsoft Teams and Confluence
comment: For Agentic AI platforms, the operational challenge goes beyond deployment—model governance, prompt versioning, cost controls, and tracing agent decisions will be key for production reliability.
